text_to_image_prompt:
East Asian man with messy warm blond short hair, light playful confident charm, fitted charcoal tee and tiny silver ear stud. Facial features: square-oval face, strong cheek width, softly curved brows, rounded slightly wide-set brown eyes, broad short nose with subtle tip definition, small cupid-bow mouth, medium warm complexion.

Create one photorealistic fictional adult male portrait, vertical 3:4, exactly 1086 x 1448 pixels. Standard ID-photo head-and-shoulders composition, camera exactly at pupil height, upright perfectly frontal head, level squared shoulders, direct gaze into lens, zero yaw/pitch/roll. Relaxed neutral expression, lips gently closed, no open-mouth smile. Complete hair visible with white headroom, equal side margins, centered face, crop at upper chest. Flat opaque pure white #FFFFFF background, bright soft frontal studio light with low shadows, natural pores and realistic skin texture, subtle halation, natural 50mm perspective, both eyes and face sharply focused with gentle shallow depth of field. No props, hands, text, logos, watermark, borders, collage, transparency or background gradients.
original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied image into ONE photorealistic front-facing eye-level ID portrait of the SAME fictional adult man. Input image is the sole identity and clothing authority. Preserve exactly his distinctive facial proportions, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, jaw, complexion, age, hair color and style, facial hair, accessories and clothing. Change ONLY camera alignment, head/shoulder orientation, framing and neutral expression as needed. True straight-on front view, zero yaw/pitch/roll, upright head, level shoulders, eyes looking directly at an eye-level camera. Relaxed neutral expression, lips gently closed. Standardized centered head-and-shoulders ID-photo composition, crop at upper chest, full hair visible with 8% white headroom, face prominent, equal side margins, eye line at 40% of canvas height. Vertical canvas EXACTLY 1086 x 1448 pixels, 3:4 aspect ratio. Pure flat opaque white #FFFFFF background to every edge. Bright soft frontal studio light, very low shadow, faithful natural skin texture and fine pores, subtle halation, natural 50mm lens perspective, gently shallow depth of field but both eyes and entire face clearly sharp. Keep the original attractiveness and individuality. No beautification changing identity, no face redesign, no tilted head, no three-quarter view, no hands, props, text, watermark, border, collage, transparency or gradient background. Output one individual portrait.
